---
title: "PAQ radar plot"
description: "Compare the eight PAQs of two soundscapes on a radar chart."
date: 2026-01-16
categories: [radar]
tags: [Visualizations]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-paq-radar
#| fig-alt: "Radar plot of PAQ ratings for two soundscapes"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

paqs = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Location": ["Park", "Street"],
        "pleasant": [4.2, 2.1],
        "vibrant": [3.5, 4.2],
        "eventful": [2.8, 4.5],
        "chaotic": [1.5, 3.9],
        "annoying": [1.2, 3.7],
        "monotonous": [2.5, 1.8],
        "uneventful": [3.1, 1.9],
        "calm": [4.3, 1.4],
    }
)

sspy.paq_radar_plot(paqs, index="Location", title="PAQ profile: park vs street")
plt.show()
```
